title: Flutter Developer Intern – Mobile & AI
description:
**Company:** Big Wings LLC / TechTruckers  
**Position:** Flutter Developer Intern – Mobile \& AI  
**Experience:** Freshers / 0–2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Internship with potential for long\-term opportunity  
**Work Mode:** Bangalore Office**About the Role**We are looking for a motivated **Flutter Developer Intern** who has a strong interest in **mobile application development and Artificial Intelligence**.This role is suitable for both **fresh graduates and developers with early professional experience** who want to work on real\-world products rather than only small development tasks.You will work alongside our existing product and development teams to build **new and parallel mobile applications for multiple products**, including transportation, logistics, fleet management, repair/service platforms, and AI\-enabled applications.The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking a feature from **requirement → UI → API integration → testing → deployment**, while also exploring how AI can be integrated into mobile applications.**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop cross\-platform mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build new/parallel mobile apps for different company products.
* Convert product requirements and Figma designs into functional mobile applications.
* Integrate Flutter applications with **REST APIs and backend services**.
* Implement authentication, notifications, file/document uploads, location services, maps, and other mobile functionality.
* Work with state\-management approaches such as **Provider, Riverpod, BLoC, or GetX**.
* Integrate AI\-powered functionality into mobile applications using APIs and SDKs.
* Work with **LLM/Generative AI APIs**, voice, OCR, document processing, or AI assistants where required.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, UI/UX designers, backend developers, AI developers, and QA.
* Debug application issues and improve performance and reliability.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, releases, and technical discussions.
* Research new Flutter and AI technologies and propose practical ways to use them within our products.

**AI Skills We Are Looking For**You do **not** need to be an AI/ML expert.However, you should understand how modern applications can consume AI services and should be interested in areas such as:

* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* AI API integration
* Prompt engineering
* Chatbot / AI assistant integration
* Speech\-to\-Text and Text\-to\-Speech
* Voice assistants
* OCR and document extraction
* Image/document processing
* AI agents and tool/function calling
* Using AI coding tools effectively during development

Experience with APIs or platforms such as **OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Hugging Face, or similar AI services** is an advantage.**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of **Flutter and Dart**
* Understanding of mobile application architecture
* REST API integration
* JSON handling
* Git / GitHub
* Basic knowledge of state management
* Understanding of asynchronous programming
* Mobile UI development and responsive layouts
* Debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Basic understanding of Android/iOS application lifecycle
* Strong willingness to learn and experiment with AI technologies

**Good to Have**Experience or academic/personal projects involving any of the following would be highly valued:

* Firebase
* Push notifications
* Google Maps / HERE Maps / Map APIs
* GPS and background location
* Camera and document uploads
* Offline data/storage
* WebSockets / real\-time communication
* Voice commands
* OCR
* AI chatbots
* LLM APIs
* Driver, logistics, fleet, ERP, or field\-service applications

**Who Can Apply?**We welcome:

* Fresh graduates in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, AI, or related disciplines
* Final\-year students with strong development skills
* Flutter developers with **0–2 years of experience**
* Self\-taught developers with strong Flutter projects
* Candidates who have built Flutter \+ AI projects independently
* Developers who actively use modern AI development tools and are keen to learn

**A strong GitHub portfolio or working application can compensate for limited professional experience.What We Will Evaluate**Rather than focusing only on years of experience, we will evaluate candidates on:

* Flutter fundamentals and coding ability
* Ability to build an app independently
* API integration knowledge
* Problem\-solving and debugging
* Code structure and maintainability
* Understanding of AI/LLM integration
* GitHub/personal projects
* Ability to understand product requirements
* Communication and willingness to learn
* Ability to work independently in a remote team

**Why Join Us?**This is not an internship focused only on minor bug fixes.You will have opportunities to **build real applications, work on production features, integrate AI capabilities, and contribute to products from an early stage**.For candidates who demonstrate strong technical ability, ownership, and consistent performance, there may be an opportunity to transition into a **full\-time Flutter Developer / Mobile AI Developer role**.

Work Location: In person

In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
   

  

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with android systems and applications, with managing issues and research across Android.
* Experience with Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)\-level programming.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 8 years of experience with android systems and applications, with managing issues and research across Android.
* Experience with mobile and desktop gaming.
* Ability to build performant, and secure systems.
* Excellent technical communication and collaboration skills.


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 Our team is responsible for delivering a quality gaming experience allowing the users to play their Android and native games across form factors.
   

  

 In this role, you will manage cross\-system integration and performance tests across the operating system (e.g., input, graphics, audio, etc.). You will help the small team move at a pace to hit deadlines.
   

  

 Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement features to ensure a performant, reliable multi\-platform gameplay experience to delight the users.
* Write and review code, design docs, and test plans to ensure quality work.
* Partner with product management, program management, and User Experience (UX) to solve problems and deliver business impact.
* Solve problems that balance technical considerations (e.g., maintainability, scalability, reliability, availability, efficiency, security) with business/product requirements.
* Work on software development, deployment and production practices.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience building products for emerging markets, next billion users, or optimizing app performance for memory\-constrained/low\-end Android devices.
* Demonstrated experience launching mobile consumer products at scale with a focus on product growth, user funnels or acquisition.
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture, client\-server latency optimization, Operating System (OS) permissions (e.g., location/notifications), and API/SDK integrations.
* Strong track record in growth product management, consumer mobile apps, referral ingress, push notification systems, or onboarding conversion.


**About The Job**
 Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real\-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B\+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world\-scale impact.
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will help drive Maps' reach towards 3B monthly active users (MAUs). You will join the International Growth team, with a focus on growing Android Maps (aka aGMM) Reach by creating new and improving existing acquisition and re\-activation flywheels. You will drive sustainable, high\-velocity user growth and engagement across top Android growth markets (including US, India, Indonesia, Brazil, Vietnam etc) while systematically eliminating friction in the user journey. The team operates at the intersection of product intuition, deep data analytics, and rigorous experimentation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the multi\-quarter strategy and tactical execution plan for global Android Google Mobile Maps (aGMM) MAU growth, daily visits, and users on Google Maps.
* Conduct funnel analyses to pinpoint drop\-offs, churn drivers, and user cohorts.
* Design, launch, and analyze high\-velocity A/B tests and causal holdback experiments to validate product hypotheses.
* Partner with engineering to streamline app startup latency, payload footprints, and first\-interaction times on entry\-tier devices.
* Partner closely with dedicated Engineering teams, Data Science/Analytics, UX Design, Research, Legal, and Product Marketing across geographies.

title: Flutter Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Flutter Mobile Developer** with 3\+ years of professional hands\-on experience in developing and delivering production\-level mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Flutter development, state management, API integration, mobile application architecture, debugging, and build/release processes. The candidate should be capable of independently developing and maintaining Flutter applications throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high\-quality mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Develop and deliver production\-ready Flutter applications for Android and iOS platforms.
* Implement application state management using **Provider and BLoC**.
* Integrate REST APIs using **Dio** and handle HTTP/JSON\-based communication.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable Flutter components.
* Implement JSON parsing and API integration.
* Understand and work with Flutter application architecture and lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development and production environments.
* Collaborate with backend developers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Use **Git** for source code management and follow appropriate branching and version\-control practices.
* Support mobile application build, deployment, and release processes.
* Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards and best practices.
* Ensure application performance, stability, security, and responsiveness.

Mandatory Skills

* **3\+ years of professional hands\-on experience in Flutter**
* Strong **Dart programming** knowledge
* Hands\-on experience with **Provider**
* Hands\-on experience with **BLoC**
* Experience with **Dio** for API integration
* Strong understanding of **HTTP/REST APIs**
* Experience developing and delivering **production\-level Flutter applications**
* Ability to independently write and understand basic **Dart/Flutter code**
* Experience with **Git**
* Working knowledge of **Android Studio or Visual Studio Code**
* Working knowledge of **Xcode**
* Experience developing mobile applications for **Android and/or iOS**

Pay: Up to ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
